attchmntText: Nephrocare Health Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Nephrocare Health Services Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 4, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue of INR585 crores, up 24% year-on-year, with adjusted EBITDA of INR135 crores at a 23% margin. Q2 revenue reached INR303 crores, a 23.5% increase. The network expanded to 570 clinics across six countries, including new entries in Kazakhstan and Saudi Arabia. Management highlighted strategic growth levers such as geographic expansion and clinic acquisitions. The company remains net cash with INR507 crores in deposits against INR80 crores in borrowings. It reiterated medium-term revenue growth guidance of 15% to 20% over three to four years. The transcript was uploaded to the company website and submitted to BSE and NSE under SEBI listing regulations.

attchmntText: Nephrocare Health Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Nephrocare Health Services Limited, trading as Nephroplus, has announced that its officials will attend an Investor Conference on 17th November, 2026, starting at 12:00 PM IST. The event is part of the Avendus Spark Conference and will include group and one-to-one meetings hosted by Avendus Spark at the Grand Hyatt in Mumbai. The company confirmed that discussions will rely solely on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be shared during the interactions. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company noted that changes to the schedule may occur due to exigencies. The full disclosure is available on the company website at www.nephroplus.com. The notice was signed by Kishore Kathri, Company Secretary and Head Legal.
